patthana13.11:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho dhammo uppajjati, hetupaccayā, sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na neva sekha na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekho ca na neva sekha na asekho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho ca na asekho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana13.11:2.1: pañca. asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekho dhammo uppajjati, hetupaccayā, asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na neva sekha na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho ca na nevasekho nāsekho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho ca na asekho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana13.11:3.1: pañca. neva sekha na asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, neva sekha na asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, neva sekhā nāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho ca na asekho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana13.11:4.1: tīṇi. sekhañca neva sekha na asekhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, sekhañca neva sekha na asekhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. sekhañca neva sekha na asekhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho ca na asekho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana13.11:5.1: tīṇi. asekhañca neva sekha na asekhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, asekhañca neva sekha na asekhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, asekhañca nevasekhā na asekhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekho ca na asekho ca dhammā uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
